page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-60-lssd is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9B14 processor. It features 60 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 30 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system is equipped with 480 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of 1608 GB of high-speed NVMe SSD capacity spread across four local drives.

In performance evaluations, the instance demonstrates strong capabilities across compute and memory subsystems. Stress-ng benchmarks place both single-core and multi-core CPU performance in the top 25%. Memory subsystem testing reveals strong cached read bandwidth for small blocks, though uncached large-block read and write speeds fall into the average range. The server excels in database operations, with Passmark database tests and Redis SET operations scoring in the top 25%, the latter achieving 78.41 million operations per second.

The hardware configuration offers a balanced tradeoff between high-density memory and fast local NVMe storage, making it highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring rapid data access without the overhead of external storage. However, the lack of a dedicated GPU limits its efficiency for heavy deep learning training, although it maintains strong performance for medium-sized LLM text generation. This server is highly suited for large-scale in-memory databases, high-throughput web serving, software compilation, and data-intensive ETL pipelines.
